summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressFileContext classes, _make_file_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file with overloads, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods); tests/test_progress.py (17 new tests before the script-entry block); docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased/Added bullet linking PR 1759). Only additions, nothing committed. Not verified: tests, mypy, and black were not run per instructions. Deviation from spec: the module-level open implementation takes mode as Any so it can call the overloaded Progress.open without an unsanctioned suppression. Suppression placement and mypy unused-ignore behaviour should be checked when the suite is run.
